3nd Annual Breast Cancer Awareness/Benefit Game
Join the Williamsburg Senior Softball League (WSSL) for the 3rd Annual Breast Cancer Awareness/Benefit Game on Sunday, Oct. 26, at 3 p.m. at Kiwanis Park, 125 Longhill Road, Williamsburg. This special exhibition softball game honors Breast Cancer Awareness Month and raises funds for the Virginia Breast Cancer Foundation. First organized in 2023 by the women of the league, the event continues to grow as players and supporters unite for a great cause. Enjoy an afternoon of friendly competition, community spirit, and support for breast cancer research and advocacy. All proceeds directly benefit efforts to increase awareness, provide education, and promote early detection. Come out, wear pink, and cheer on your favorite teams for a meaningful game with heart.
Yorktoberfest Craft Beer Festival
Raise a glass and celebrate autumn at the Yorktoberfest Craft Beer Festival on Sunday, Oct. 26, from Noon-5:30 p.m. at Riverwalk Landing, 331 Water Street, Yorktown. This annual waterfront event features a wide selection of craft beers, ciders, and wines from local and regional breweries, along with live music, delicious food vendors, and artisan crafts. Sample seasonal brews while enjoying beautiful views of the York River and the lively festival atmosphere. Tickets range from $10-40, depending on tasting options, with proceeds supporting local community programs. Gather your friends for an afternoon of flavor, fun, and fall festivities at one of Yorktown’s most anticipated annual celebrations—Yorktoberfest!
